terms.grammar: imperative of parcō, parcere, pepercī, parsum
evidence: Plaut. Poen. 1.2.40: soror, parce, amābō (Lewis & Short s.v. amō)
terms.comment: To spare, to hold back: Parce! asks someone to go easy or stop, not to relax.

sources: Lewis & Short: otiosus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 19.
Lewis & Short: parco
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 108.
